fw_throughput_appmix_mbps.label: Firewall throughput (HTTP/appmix)
test_conditions: Firewall throughput is measured with App-ID and logging enabled, using 64 KB HTTP/appmix transactions.
fw_throughput_appmix_mbps.note: Datasheet prints HTTP/appmix; value is the appmix number.

threat_prevention_throughput_mbps.label: Threat Prevention throughput (HTTP/appmix)
test_conditions: Threat Prevention throughput is measured with App-ID, IPS, antivirus, antispyware, WildFire, DNS Security, file blocking, and logging enabled, utilizing 64 KB HTTP/appmix transactions.
threat_prevention_throughput_mbps.note: Datasheet prints HTTP/appmix; value is the appmix number.

ipsec_throughput_mbps.label: IPsec VPN throughput
test_conditions: IPsec VPN throughput is measured with 64 KB HTTP transactions and logging enabled.

concurrent_sessions.label: Max concurrent sessions
test_conditions: Max concurrent sessions are measured utilizing HTTP transactions.

new_sessions_per_sec.label: New sessions per second
test_conditions: New sessions per second is measured with application override utilizing 1 byte HTTP transactions. PA-800 Series ML-Powered NGFWs support a wide range of networking features that enable you to more easily integrate our security features into your existing network.
